# Backups API

A backup is a zip of the app's `pb_data`, kept in `pb_data/backups` or in S3 (**Settings → Backups**). All endpoints are
for **superusers**. PocketOne also records every change for [point-in-time restore](https://pocketone.dev/docs/features/restore), which
these full backups sit beside.

## List backups

`GET /api/backups`

```json
[{ "key": "pb_backup_20261123030000.zip", "size": 1048576, "modified": "2026-11-23 03:00:01.000Z" }]
```

## Make a backup

`POST /api/backups` with an optional `{"name": "before-migration.zip"}` (default: a timestamped name). Answers `204`
when it's done, which takes a while for a big app. One backup or restore runs at a time.

## Download a backup

`GET /api/backups/{key}?token=...`

Takes a superuser's file token in the URL, from [`POST /api/files/token`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/rest/files#protected-files), so a
browser can download it directly.

## Upload a backup

`POST /api/backups/upload`, `multipart/form-data` with the zip in `file`. Answers `204`.

## Delete a backup

`DELETE /api/backups/{key}` (`204`).

## Restore a backup

`POST /api/backups/{key}/restore`

Replaces `pb_data` with the backup and restarts the app (answers `204` before the restart). Everything since the backup
is gone, so make a backup first.
